name: xorn
lore:
Imagine the earth trembling, not from the tread of giants, but from a subtle, almost imperceptible vibration. A glint of mica catches your eye, and then you see it – a bizarre, radially symmetrical form erupting from the stone. Three arms tipped with talons, three eyes gleaming with alien intelligence, and a gaping maw at the apex of its rocky body. This is a xorn, a creature born of the Elemental Plane of Earth, driven by an insatiable hunger for minerals and gems.

These beings are not inherently malicious, but their desires are as alien as their forms. To them, a vein of quartz is as succulent as a ripe fruit, and a fistful of diamonds is a feast fit for a king. Tread carefully in their domain, for a hungry xorn is a dangerous xorn, and their definition of sustenance may include the very treasures you seek. Offer them tribute, and they might become invaluable allies, guiding you through the labyrinthine tunnels and revealing hidden veins of ore. Deny them, and you will face the wrath of a creature perfectly adapted to the unforgiving embrace of the earth.
